summary: Registration hero with the Nov 27 opening and the discount windows (Black Friday $50 off, Early Bird $25 off, full price from Jan 1), three steps for new families, division chart and 2027 fees, each with a Baseball/Softball switch, Challenger card with its contact, Fall Ball 2026 scoreboard, then the sign-up list.
blurb: How to sign up for spring, with discount dates, steps for new families, and baseball and softball divisions and fees.

sources.fact: Challenger Division is adaptive baseball for players with physical and intellectual challenges, ages 4 to 18 (up to 22 if still in school); questions to vpchallenger@blslittleleague.org.
Fall Ball 2026 had 8 divisions: Tee Ball (co-ed); Baseball Coach Pitch, AA, Minors, Majors; Softball Minors B, Minors A, Majors.
Fall Ball 2026 games ran Sep 12 through Oct 31.

Spring 2027 registration windows (board motion passed Nov 1): Black Friday sale Nov 27 to 29, $50 off per family; Early Bird Nov 30 to Dec 31, $25 off per family; full price from Jan 1, 2027. Minutes are up for board approval Dec 6.
2027 registration prices (board motions passed Nov 1): Tee Ball $90, Coach Pitch $150, AA $275, Minors and Majors $295, 50/70 and Juniors $300; all softball divisions $10 less than baseball.
Coach 11/4: Tee Ball stays $90 for everyone (co-ed); softball is $10 less than baseball (Minors B $140, Minors A $285). Prices must not go public before the board announces them to families.

later: VP of Baseball (Jeremy Olsen) and VP of Softball (Luke Kress): 2027 registration deadlines (in 2026 upper divisions closed Feb 1, lower divisions went to a waitlist Mar 1, Challenger closed Mar 1, and Juniors and 50/70 ran to Mar 10).

VP of Softball (Luke Kress): spring 2027 softball division names and league ages for the Softball tab of the division chart, and which fee each takes. The fee tab uses the board's names (Coach Pitch $140, Minors $285, Majors $285, Juniors $290) while the chart shows Minors B and Minors A; if softball AA runs in spring (the Nov 1 board added a Softball AA/Coach Pitch Player Agent), it needs a tile too.
VP of Baseball (Jeremy Olsen): is spring Minors league age 9 to 11 (this chart and the FAQ) or AAA 10 to 11 (Fall Ball page)?
VP of Baseball (Jeremy Olsen): will 50/70 and Juniors run in 2027, and is Juniors 13 to 14 (this chart) or 13 to 15 (a Mar 2026 post)?
League Player Agent (Jason Guertin) with the VPs: spring 2027 evaluation dates and places, and Opening Day 2027 (2026 was Apr 25 at Allan Yorke Field 5), to add once set.
VP of Challenger (Mandie Pitingoro, voted in Nov 1): the 2027 Challenger registration window, and confirm vpchallenger@blslittleleague.org reaches them.
required: Board: a prices note to families (news post and Facebook, with the why) before the fee table goes up
